issue.title: Build Projects Tab
issue.body: Fluent Mobile is a companion app for oral Bible translators working in remote, low-connectivity environments. The Projects tab allows users to browse all projects available to them and drill into any project to view and access its chapters, regardless of assignment status. ## Functional Requirements ### Page Header Identical to the Page Header in #31. See that ticket for the full spec. ### Top-Level Tabs Two full-width tabs — My Work and Projects — rendered below the page header. This ticket covers the Projects tab. See #31 for the My Work tab spec. ### Projects Tab - Display a flat, scrollable list of all projects available to the user. - Each project row displays: - project name, - a sync state indicator, - target language, - total chapter count (e.g. "42 chapters"), and - a right-facing arrow `li:chevron-right` indicating drilldown navigation. - Sync state indicator - Reflects the aggregate upload state of all chapters in the project. - If any chapter has unsynced work, the project shows the not-fully-synced state. - All chapters synced: `li:cloud-check`, green (`#16A34A`) - Any chapter not synced: `li:cloud-upload`, yellow (`#FBBF24`) - No work recorded in the project: no indicator shown - Tapping a project row navigates to the View Project page. See #33 for that spec. ### Projects Tab — Empty State - When the project list is empty for any reason, display: "No projects are available right now. Connect to the internet to sync and find available work."
